SCOPE OF WORK S. No. Make Model Location Room No. 1 HP LaserJet MFP M436nd Accounts Division 203 a 1. This contract shall be of All Inclusive AMC fully Comprehensive and On-Site at NCTE Office, Dwarka, Delhi. The replacement of items will be genuine and a s per the equipment. No recycled replacement is acceptable. 2. The contract will include supply/repair/replacement cum maintenance of all Hardware, defective parts of Photocopier machine. 3. It shall also include supply/repair/replacement, supply and update of softwar e necessary for smooth functioning of the Photocopier machine as specified by the OEM time to time. 4. The parts to be installed in place of defective parts should be of the same br and and specifications. In case of non-availability of the parts, to be replaced, o f the same brand, the choice of parts of a company of particular brand will be t he discretion of this office. 5. The contract shall also include periodic cum preventive maintenance of hard ware and software at an interval not more than three months or on requiremen t whichever is earlier. The maintenance service shall consist of preventive, bre akdown and superlative maintenance/repair of Photocopier machine to ensure minimum breakdown and quality performance as specified by the OEM. 6. The bidder shall submit authorisation of OEM for participation in the bid. TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR AMC OF PHOTOCOPIER MACHINES 1. This Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) shall remain in force for one year from the date commencement of work. After completion of the initial contract period, the contract may be extended on mutually agreed terms, subject to satisfacto ry performance. The total contract period may be extended up to two (2) ad ditional years, with each extension not exceeding one (1) year at a time. 2. The AMC here under covers corrective maintenance and free replacement of defective components in the Photocopier machines i.e. including all plastic parts for smooth functioning included under this tender. The AMC shall consist of preventive , breakdown and superlative maintenance of Photocopier machine covered under AMC. 3. The Vendor/Firm placed with the contract shall report to NCTE Office in person or through his authorized representative within one week of placing of order an d shall render a certificate for acceptance of the same and commencement of work. 4. The Cost of AMC shall be inclusive of GST and all other Octoroi.

5. The Vendor/Firm shall be liable to carry out periodic/preventive maintenan ce work in every month at their own. The program for periodic/preventive maintenanc e work shall be intimated to the NCTE Office at least in a week advance. It shall be the res ponsibility of the Vendor/Firm to replace unserviceable/worn-out parts as and when requir ed and noticed during maintenance in order to keep the Photocopier machine in full working condition. 6. The preventive maintenance of each Photocopier machine (PCP) i s to be carried out as follows: - i. Regular and through cleaning of the machines from inside (once in ev ery month) by computer grade air and liquid cleaning solution to remove dirt and dust which hinders the cooling of PCBs during operation. The sol ution should be free from moisture. Caution should be exercised to preve nt the damage due to static charge. ii. Cleaning and lubrication off all connectors and contacts of Photocopie r machine regularly. iii. Carrying out the head cleaning (once in every month). iv. Cleaning out the exterior of all other accessories. Good quality cleanin g liquid is to be used for such purpose (once in every month). v. Periodical service and maintenance of machine every 30 days includi ng change of spare parts in case found defective. 7. In case of breakdown of equipment, the Vendor/Firm shall ensure visit of their repair team to the site in maximum one working days from the date of intimation from the NCTE Office. 8. The equipment shall be repaired on-site only and in no case the complete equipment shall be allowed to be taken out from the premises for repair or any other purpose. The equipment shall be made functional in maximum two working days from the date of intimation. 9. In cases, the defect needs extensive repair and its repair cannot be carried out on-site, the defective parts (except any memory devices) only can be taken out for repa ir after undergoing due security procedure of the office. In such cases, the down time shall not be more than one week of calendar days. 10. The cost for AMC shall include the cost of visit of Vendor/Firm or its representatives to the site and back, as well as any transportation and alli ed expenditure incurred on items or personnel. 11. The maintenance will be carried out in normal office working hours only on all working days. 12. The Vendor/Firm or the representative of Vendor/Firm shall report to Admin- II Division of this office first on arrival at site. Subsequently, the work undertaken on t he equipment/equipments for repair/maintenance shall be submitted to SO (Admin-II) in writing duly initiated by the end user/users immediately on completion o

f the work before leaving the place. 13. Any damage caused/occurred to the equipment during maintenance/repair s hall be made good by the firm in original condition at their own expense. 14. No alterations/attachment/adjustment shall be made to the hardware /software the equipment/equipments that can decrease/reduce the actual capability of the m achine as specified by the OEM. All parts replaced must be of same specification and of OEM make, if such parts are not available in the market due to obsolescence; parts of e quivalent or higher quality be replaced. 15. I f any machine is considered as Beyond Economical Repair it is the responsibility of Vendor/Firm to provide “BER certificate from its OEM” for declaration of “BER”. 16. The billing can be done minimum at quarterly interval. 17. The payment shall be done by the paying authority as notified on the GeM portal on successful processing of bills by the vendor/firm as per the departmental procedure. 18. The bills shall be processed through Admin-II Division on production of following documents:- i. Invoice generated on the Vendor’s letterhead duly stamped and signed (in original) by the vendor/firm. ii. The invoice shall have the GST and other Tax elements mentioned separately. iii. Work done statement and completion reports of all the jobs carried out in the period as mentioned earlier. iv. Necessary stamp/revenue fees as applicable as per the government procedure. 19. The bidder shall submit authorisation of OEM for participation in the bid. Special conditions 1. In case of any dispute in understanding the terms and conditions, the decision of NCTE Office shall be final and binding on this. 2. It shall be open to either-party to terminate this contract any time during the currency b y giving one month notice to the other party in writing without any financial effect. 3. The NCTE reserves the right of cancellation of contract any time if not satisfied with the performance/service of the Firm with due notice of 15 days. 4. The contractor shall ensure that the machines are in good working condition and are wit h full configuration while handing over at the end of the AMC. 5. There should not be an y revision of rate during the currency of the AMC. 6. The old retrieved material will be the property of the user and will be hande d over to the store keeper. 7. This AMC shall include all items including consumables like toner and drum.

8. All other terms and conditions given in the GeM portal stands applied to it. In case of an y dispute between the two above mentioned terms and conditions takes precedence. 9. The terms and conditions given above are deemed to be agreed and accepted. Documents Required: - 1. Attested copy of PAN No. 2. Attested copy of Aadhar Card 3. Attested copy of GST Certificate 4. Average Annual Turnover as per ATC duly certified by CA 5. Manufacturer Authorization Form (MAF) of OEM in r/o Photocopier Machines. 6. Availability of Office of Service Provider: An office of the Service Provider must be located in t he state of Consignee. Documentary evidence to be submitted. 7. Past Experience of similar work as per ATC - with Purchase orders and executed invoices alon g with completion document through GeM Portal 8. The agency/firm/company is neither blacklisted by any central/state government/ Autonomou s Body/PSU nor is any Criminal case registered against the Agency/Firm / Company. Undertaki ng of not blacklisted will attached on Technical Bids on company letter head otherwise bids wil l be rejected 9. Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or si milar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid 10. Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support: BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support 11. Escalation Matrix For Service Support: Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support CHECKLIST FOR BIDDERS Sl.
